violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the front counter area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (beverages) in the 2 Dr Reach in. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

(Cut watermelon) was observed held at (71) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Melon was observed being stored outside on table. PIC informed that melons must be at 41 degrees or colder once cut. PIC put melons on ice during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The presence of (fruit flies ) is not controlled as evidenced by (live activity ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (retail area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Utensils is stored on an unclean surface (top of the table outside) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location.PIC moved to 3 bay sink area for washing and sanitizing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
Inspector observed linen cloths being used to cover cooked meat in walk in cooler. PIC informed to cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (slicer ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
